_comment: Single source of truth for the current monthly workshop. Edited each month by the workshop skill, then used to regenerate the funnel. Date is Melbourne local; the skill works out the timezone (AEST/AEDT) automatically.
title: The Unfair Advantage
calendarDescription: A free hands-along hour with Kelly at Wise Women Use AI. Build the one place your content lives, just by talking to Claude.

thankYou.whatWeDoingSub: One hour. You talk, Claude does the sorting, and you leave with a real start.

cards.title: Claude and Notion, connected
cards.body: We'll link the two together at the start, so Claude can build straight into your Notion while you talk. Already connected? Even better, you'll be straight into the good part.

cards.title: Your content pillars, named
cards.body: The handful of things you're actually here to talk about, out of your head and on the page where you can see them.

cards.title: A one-page Content Command Centre
cards.body: One calm home for all of it, with a simple calendar you can keep going even on a bad week.

cards.title: Your first few days, filled in
cards.body: We'll do the first ones together, so you leave with something real to build on instead of another blank page.

thankYou.beforeSub: A few things that'll make the hour more useful for you.

steps.title: Connect Claude and Notion before the day, if you can
steps.body: A Claude Pro account and a Notion account, linked together. We'll do it quickly at the start, but you'll get far more out of the hour if it's already done. Never connected them before? July's workshop walks through it properly and it's free to watch: the July replay is here. And if it plays up on the day, don't worry, you'll build the page anyway and I'll send the walkthrough after.

steps.title: Bring the things you already talk about
steps.body: The questions you get asked, the parts of your work you love, the thing you always end up explaining. Half-formed is perfect. That's the raw material Claude turns into your pillars.

steps.title: Come with your camera off and your tea on
steps.body: No hot seats, no homework before you arrive. Just show up.
